---
title: "Random validation"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
# This function extracts randomly a sample of 20 Reports.

extract_random_rows <- function(file_path, n = 20, seed = 123) {
  set.seed(seed)  
  df <- read_csv(file_path)
  
  # Randomize
  
  sample_df <- df %>% sample_n(n)
  
  return(sample_df)
}

# Apply it

random_rows <- extract_random_rows("Data_Manipulation _Fin_R.csv")
```

```{r}
print(random_rows)
write_csv(random_rows, "Random_Validation.csv")
```
